in_marathi.name: Gautom
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of agriculture
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gautom हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Gautom is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Gov' meaning 'cow' and 'm' meaning 'protector'. This name is a reverence to Lord Krishna, who is often depicted as the protector of cows and the God of agriculture. In Hindu tradition, Lord Krishna is considered the embodiment of love, compassion, and wisdom.
